tasks.description: Complete end-to-end validation of Trailblaze Auto covering public catalogue access, vehicle details, admin authentication, vehicle management, and booking lifecycle with strict validation and access control.
acceptance_criteria: Navigate to the landing page ('/'). Verify that the hero section contains the branding text 'Elegance for'. Verify that the navigation bar contains a 'Catalogue' link with ID 'browse-link'.
Click the 'Catalogue' link in the navigation bar. Verify that the application redirects to the browse page ('/browse') and that the vehicle inventory grid with ID 'car-grid' is successfully rendered.

Inspect the car cards on the '/browse' page. Verify that each vehicle's 'Brand', 'Name', and 'Price' (e.g., '₹1,20,00,000') are correctly displayed using the specific ID selectors car-card-{id}-brand, car-card-{id}-name, and car-card-{id}-price.
Click on any vehicle card within the grid. Verify that the browser navigates to the car details page at '/car/[id]' and that the dynamic vehicle data is correctly populated from the API.
On the Car Details page, click the 'Specs' tab. Verify that the technical specifications section renders 'Transmission' and 'System' (Fuel Type) information that matches the vehicle's record.
On the '/browse' page, click the 'New' filter option in the condition dropdown. Verify that only vehicles with the 'Brand New' status badge are visible in the inventory grid.
On the '/browse' page, click the 'Pre-Owned' filter option in the condition dropdown. Verify that only vehicles with the 'Pre-Owned' status badge are visible in the inventory grid.
Click the 'All' filter option in the condition dropdown. Verify that the inventory grid resets to display the complete list of available vehicles, including both new and used conditions.

Navigate to a 'Used' vehicle's details page and click the 'Price' tab. Verify that a 'Financial Breakdown' section is rendered, specifically displaying the 'Owner Depreciation' calculation based on the vehicle's history.

Navigate to the admin registration page ('/admin/signup'). Fill the 'Full Legal Name', 'Corporate Email', and 'Access Password' fields with valid data and click 'Create Account'. Verify that a toast 'Account created successfully' appears and the user is redirected to the '/admin' login page.

Access the '/admin' login page and enter valid credentials. Verify that upon clicking the 'Login' button, the application stores the 'adminToken' in localStorage, displays the 'Access Granted.' toast, and redirects to '/admin/dashboard'.
Attempt to login at '/admin' with incorrect credentials. Verify that the application displays an 'Authentication failed.' (or similar error) toast and prevents redirection to the dashboard.

Clear the 'adminToken' from localStorage and attempt to navigate directly to '/admin/dashboard'. Verify that the application immediately redirects the unauthorized user back to the '/admin' login page.
Upon loading the Admin Dashboard, verify that the 'Vehicles' tab renders the 'Inventory Overview' table and the 'Bookings' tab renders the 'Incoming Requests' table with accurate data.

Open the 'Add Car' page. Fill all mandatory fields for a 'New' vehicle across all steps (Brand, Name, Price, Transmission, Fuel, Insurance Validity, and Main Image). Click 'Save Vehicle'. Verify the 'Vehicle added successfully!' toast and redirection to the dashboard.

In the 'Add Car' wizard, select 'Used' condition. Verify that the form now requires 'Number of Owners' and 'Registration City'. Complete the entry with valid 'Past Owner History' records and verify that the data persists in the database.

On the 'Add Car' page, leave the 'Car Name' (Model) field empty and attempt to proceed to the next step. Verify that the application displays a toast message 'Please fill in all basic information' and blocks navigation to the next step.

Access the 'Edit Car' page for an existing vehicle. Modify the 'Price (₹)' value and click 'Save Changes'. Verify the 'Vehicle updated successfully!' toast and ensure the new price is reflected on the public Car Details page.

In the Admin Dashboard, click the 'Sign Out' button in the navigation bar. Verify that the 'adminToken' is removed from localStorage, a toast 'Logged out successfully' appears, and the user is redirected to the home page.

Navigate to the 'Admin Profile' page ('/admin/profile'). Update the 'Full Legal Name' and 'Professional Bio' fields and click 'Synchronize Profile Data'. Verify that the success toast 'Profile updated successfully!' is displayed.

On the 'Admin Profile' page, clear the mandatory 'Full Legal Name' field and click 'Synchronize Profile Data'. Verify that the browser's native HTML5 validation (required attribute) blocks the submission.

On the 'Admin Profile' page, enter a new password in the 'Update Password' field and click 'Synchronize Profile Data'. Log out and verify that the admin can successfully log in using the newly updated password.
Navigate to any vehicle's public detail page and click the 'Book Now' button. Verify that the 'PurchaseModal' opens, displaying the vehicle's brand, name, and a booking form.

Fill the 'PurchaseModal' form with a valid 'Full Name', 'Email', and 'Contact' number. Click the 'Book Now' submit button. Verify that the API returns a 201 status code and the booking record is created.
Upon successful submission of the booking form, verify that the 'Booking request sent! Our team will contact you soon.' toast is displayed and the 'PurchaseModal' automatically closes.

In the 'PurchaseModal', enter an invalid email format (e.g., 'test@') and attempt to submit. Verify that the application displays a toast 'Please enter a valid email address.' and blocks the API request.

Attempt to submit a booking for the same vehicle with an already used email address. Verify that the application returns a 400 error from the API and displays the toast 'A booking request with this email already exists for this vehicle.'
Login to the admin area and navigate to the 'Bookings' tab in the dashboard. Verify that all submitted customer booking requests are accurately listed in the 'Incoming Requests' table.

Locate a 'Pending' booking in the dashboard and click the 'Accept' button. Verify that the booking status updates to 'Accepted' in the database and the application displays a toast 'Booking accepted!'.

Locate a 'Pending' booking in the dashboard and click the 'Reject' button. Verify that the booking status updates to 'Rejected' in the database and the application displays a toast 'Booking rejected!'.
Navigating to a non-existent vehicle ID at '/car/invalid-id-999' must display a 'Vehicle Not Found' message and a 'Back to Fleet' recovery button.
On a database with no booking records, navigate to the 'Bookings' tab in the Admin Dashboard. Verify that the fallback message 'No active bookings.' is visible in the table area.
